## Change

What problem does this solve, and what will the user see?

## Validation

Record the relevant automated checks and any visual checks performed.

## Data and credits

- [ ] New or changed data/assets have source, method, and credit entries.
- [ ] Synthetic visual detail stays separate from scientific calculations.
- [ ] No local attachments, raw download archives, or credentials are included.

For a release, update the version, changelog, and bundled-file manifest as applicable.
